The debris-covered fraction of the Swiss glacier area in SGI2023, from the inventory's
own debris-cover layer (product `D`): the summed area of the debris polygons over the
summed area of the glacier outlines. Both areas are the inventory's `area_km2`
attribute. SGI2016 is computed the same way as a check against the 11 % of Linsbauer et
al. (2021). The numbers are saved as a CSV in `REPORT_DIR`.

```{python}
import geopandas as gpd
import pandas as pd

from glace_production.config import settings
from glace_production.datasets import SGI2016, SGI2023
```

## Configuration

```{python}
NAME = "debris-cover"  # saved as {NAME}.csv in REPORT_DIR
REPORT_DIR = settings.reports_dir / NAME  # one folder per notebook
REPORT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

INVENTORIES = {"SGI2023": SGI2023, "SGI2016": SGI2016}
```

## Debris-covered fraction

The debris polygons lie inside the glacier outlines, so the fraction needs no
intersection; `outside_m2` is the debris area outside the outlines, to confirm it.

```{python}
def debris_row(glaciers: gpd.GeoDataFrame, debris: gpd.GeoDataFrame) -> dict[str, float]:
    glacier_km2 = glaciers["area_km2"].sum()
    debris_km2 = debris["area_km2"].sum()
    return {
        "glaciers": len(glaciers),
        "glaciers_with_debris": debris["sgi-id"].nunique(),
        "glacier_km2": glacier_km2,
        "debris_km2": debris_km2,
        "debris_pct": 100 * debris_km2 / glacier_km2,
        "outside_m2": debris.union_all().difference(glaciers.union_all()).area,
    }


table = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        name: debris_row(
            inventory(product="G").get_data(download=True),
            inventory(product="D").get_data(download=True),
        )
        for name, inventory in INVENTORIES.items()
    }
).T
table.to_csv(REPORT_DIR / f"{NAME}.csv", float_format="%.2f")
table.round(2)
```
